verdict.rationale: Plaid ships a first-party hosted Dashboard MCP server, so an AI assistant can drive some Plaid operations from natural-language requests. The documented scope is limited to Production diagnostics and analytics (debugging Items, Link conversion data, usage metrics), not general operation of the product. The language interpretation itself comes from the user's AI client rather than a native Plaid interface. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in Plaid itself, natural-language coverage of core actions (Auth, Transactions, payments, Link configuration), detailed docs of the MCP tool set, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Dashboard MCP server is a remote MCP server hosted by Plaid. It provides Production diagnostics and analytics tools, including tools for debugging Items, reviewing Link conversion data, and checking usage metrics.
official MCP server documented at https://plaid.com/docs/resources/mcp/
